sentences.text:
Chanchal Das vs Unknown on 6 December, 2024
 14
06-12-2024
(ct. no. 29)
 Kole
 Crm (Db) 2738 of 2024
 In re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal
 Procedure/Section 483 of the Bnss in connection with

Duttapukur Police Station Case No. 1114 of 2021 dated
 29.12.2021 under Sections 307/498A/304B/302 of the Indian
 Penal Code.

-And- 
 In the matter of : Chanchal Das  .... Petitioner.

Mr. Somnath Ghoshal,
 Mr. D. Karmakar,
 ...

Mr. Bitasok Banerjee,
 Ms. Trisha Rakshit,
 ... for the State.
From the report filed by the State in court today it appears that recording of evidence is complete.
December 24, 2024, has been fixed as the date for examination under Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Therefore, the trial is on the verge of conclusion.
2. In view of the prima facie incriminating material against the petitioner, we are not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail, at this stage.
4. However, considering that the petitioner has been in custody for quite some time, we request the learned Trial Court to conclude the trial as soon as possible.
5. All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.
( Apurba Sinha Ray, J. ) ( Arijit Banerjee, J. )
